name: specification-sheet
title: Packaging specification sheet: internal draft
for_each: select id,code from specs order by code

sections.title: Evidence references
sections.sql: select e.kind,e.reference,e.valid_until,e.checked_by,e.suitability_note from evidence e join current_specs s on s.revision_id=e.revision_id where s.id=$1

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule,issue from compliance_findings where id=$1

name: supplier-request
title: Supplier evidence request: draft, not sent
for_each: select id,name from suppliers order by name

sections.title: Evidence to obtain
sections.sql: select s.code,s.name,f.issue from current_specs s join compliance_findings f on f.id=s.id where s.supplier_id=$1 and f.rule in ('FOOD','RECYCLED') order by s.code

name: pack-review
title: Packaging pack review: internal draft
for_each: select id,code from products order by code

sections.title: Components
sections.sql: select product_code,spec_code,version,status,quantity,component_mass_g from product_impact where product_id=$1 order by spec_code

sections.title: Unresolved findings
sections.sql: select f.code,f.rule,f.issue from compliance_findings f join components c on c.spec_id=f.id where c.product_id=$1 order by f.code

sections.title: Mass
sections.sql: select mass_per_pack_g,claimed_recycled_g from packaging_mass where product_id=$1

name: release-record
title: Frozen packaging review: internal use
for_each: select id,id::text as name from releases order by created_at

sections.title: Frozen evidence and digest
sections.sql: select actor,created_at,digest,snapshot from releases where id=$1
sections.note: A historical internal review record. Not a declaration of conformity or permission to manufacture.
